newsitem.title: UK: UK CBI September monthly trends survey -- table.
newsitem.headline: UK CBI September monthly trends survey -- table.

text.p: Here are tabulated results from September's monthly survey of trends in UK manufacturing by employers group Confederation of British Industry (CBI).
CBI MONTHLY TRENDS ENQUIRY (a) SEPT AUGUST JULY JUNE
NOTES - * over the coming four months;
The survey was conducted between August 23 and September 11.
1,217 manufacturing companies responded, representing 50 industries and accounting for about half of the UK's manufactured exports and output of some two million employees;
- (a) in pct, giving balance between those replying "up', "above normal' or "more than adequate,' and those replying "down', "below normal' or "less than adequate.'
